create_trainer_mt: create a TrainerMT instance with encoder, decoder, discriminator, language model, data, and params
run_discriminator_step: run the discriminator training step on monolingual encoded latent representations
run_enc_dec_step: run encoder-decoder cross-entropy training step on parallel or back-translation data
run_otf_bt: run on-the-fly back-translation training with generated intermediate language batches
save_best_model: save the best model checkpoint when validation metrics improve beyond previous best
